messages:
Maria (eng-release): Hey team — created RC rc-2026-03-15a from commit 8f3d2b. Artifacts uploaded to the bucket and the smoke build passed. Asking for greenlight to promote to prod during the 13:00-14:00 UTC change window.

Maria (eng-release): Details: build: `rc-2026-03-15a`, image: `redwood/inference:rc-8f3d2b`, db-migration: deferred. Release notes stub: https://confluence.redwood.ai/RCs/rc-2026-03-15a

Kevin (sre): quick q — is there an automatic rollback plan and a pin for the previous stable if we need to revert?

Maria (eng-release): yes — rollback is scripted. Command: ```/deploy rollback --to stable-2026-03-10 --force``` We will pin stable image on the loadbalancer for 10m during promo. Ops Sheriff will have the abort if telemetry crosses thresholds.

Ops Sheriff: noted. I'll standby for canary. Telemetry gates: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency +30% for 3 consecutive mins triggers abort.

deploy-bot: Automated checks: ci/smoke ✅, infra-compat ✅, migration-safety: deferred (no schema change), canary-scripts ✅. Canary window reserved: 13:10-13:25 UTC.

Sophie (product): Release notes LGTM but we should call out the small prompt-formatting tweak that changes tokenization in a few cases — added under Known Issues.

Maria (eng-release): good call. Added note and an example prompt snippet. Also created a canary route: `/rc-canary/rc-2026-03-15a` with 5% traffic.

Kevin (sre): Start canary when ready. I'll warm KV cache first — small script: ```scripts/warm_kv.sh rc-2026-03-15a --parallel=4```

Maria (eng-release): warming now. logs: `kv-warm: 120 keys warmed, avg 12ms/key`

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: 5% -> 15% scheduled in 5m; monitor channel: #eng-sre.

Kevin (sre): Observing canary: p95 up 5% (expected), errors steady at 0.08%. Continuing.

Ops Sheriff: telemetry stable. Proceed to staged roll to 50% if no regression within 10m.

Maria (eng-release): Promoting to 50% now. Note: we're keeping db-migration as a manual follow-up in next minor; no writes touched.

deploy-bot: Promotion actions executed: traffic 15% -> 50% over 40s across regions. Pin `redwood/inference:stable` retained on fallback.

Kevin (sre): small spike in tokens/sec on eu-west — p95 still within gate (+18%). I see one alert from a downstream retrier at 13:18 but it resolved. Holding 2m to observe.

Sophie (product): I'm running a quick smoke on a fixed prompt set — results look identical to baseline for the 40 prompts we care about.

Maria (eng-release): Good. Unless Ops Sheriff calls abort, we'll proceed to 100% in next 5m. Anyone object? :bump:

Ops Sheriff: No objection. Proceed but keep the rollback command ready. I'll call abort if the error_rate spikes.

deploy-bot: Final promotion scheduled: 100% at 13:24 UTC. Pre-promotion snapshot saved: s3://redwood-release-snapshots/rc-2026-03-15a-20260315-1323.tar.gz

Maria (eng-release): Promo started -> 100% traffic. Rolling out across both primary regions.

Kevin (sre): All regions steady. p95 within +20%. No increase in 5xxs.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Health checks passing (3m). Canary metrics: error_rate 0.07%, p95 latency +17%.

Sophie (product): Verified user flows in staging lead and prod sampling — looks good. I'll merge release notes final.

Maria (eng-release): Closing thread — RC promoted to prod. Follow-up: schedule patch to address the tokenizer edge-case next sprint. Great job all :tada:

Ops Sheriff: Marking as promoted and clearing standby. If anything crops up, reopen this thread.

Kevin (sre): leaving a tiny post-deploy runbook note: if we need to roll back quickly, use the pinned loadbalancer version + `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-deploy --to-image=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-10`

Maria (eng-release): Thanks — archived notes and checklist updated.
